title: Clause dropped or wrong (9 cards)
body:
- Winter Blast: deals damage to every target, not only those with flying
- Cream of the Crop: the rest go on top of the library, not the bottom
- Moonsnare Prototype, Power of Persuasion: always the bottom, not the owner's choice of top or bottom
- Last Rites: can choose land cards, but the text says nonland
- Sworn Defender: toughness becomes the power, not 1 plus the power
- Zimone and Dina, No Secret Is Hidden from Me: "repeat this process once" encoded so it never repeats
- Awesome Presence: pays {3} once, not {3} for each blocking creature
